_comment: Phase 14.E.3: Azure Key Vault ARM (resource-manager) spec — Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults. Drives the new `azure_arm_keyvault` frontend that accepts ARM control-plane calls (azurerm Terraform provider, az keyvault CLI, Azure SDK). Vault create/get/delete acknowledge synthetically since the shim is vault-agnostic; subsequent data-plane operations (secret CRUD) go through the existing azure_keyvault frontend.
